# The settings' own widgets, fix/controls197 (Minecraft 1.21.11, 1280x720, GUI scale 3 = 427x240, the demo song). Each
# shot, the branch against main:
# - controls197-intro-last: the welcome tour's last page, All settings in the middle at the bottom (the same on both).
# - controls197-intro-double: a double-click on All settings (two clicks 0.15 s apart, the Arc layout picked). The
#   settings' Lyrics tab: Lazy follow (the 5th row) stays off on the branch; on main the second click landed on its row and
#   turned it on.
# - controls197-timing-left: Timing set to +0.12 s by hand, searched for ("Early") and Left pressed once: +0.10 s on the
#   branch, +0.05 s on main (a step and a half). controls197-timing-right: then set to +0.13 s and Right pressed once:
#   +0.15 s on the branch, +0.20 s on main.
# - controls197-reset-held: the Lyrics switch (sidebar, bottom left) turned off, then Enter held on Reset all (a press,
#   then the repeats a held key sends, 0.8 s and 0.9 s later). Branch: the switch stays off and the button reads "Click
#   again to reset". Main has no keydown command, so its run presses nothing here (on main a held Enter reset every
#   setting, the switch back on).
# - controls197-preview-held: Enter held on Preview: the preview shows (settings hidden, the hint at the bottom) and its
#   repeat doesn't hide it again. controls197-preview-back: let go and pressed again, the settings are back.
# - controls197-preview-esc: Esc held in the preview: the settings show again and stay open (main: no keydown, see above).
# The keydown and keyup commands are new on this branch; the rest runs on main too.
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=main for the old code (the script comes from --ref):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/controls197 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/controls197.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/controls197 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/controls197.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
guiscale 3
sleep 8
set layout ARC
set placement SKY
set direction FOLLOW
set lazyFollow false
set viewLock false
sleep 1

# The tour, Next four times to its last page (Next at 291-351 x 187-207, All settings at 163-263)
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 2
click 321 197
sleep 0.5
click 321 197
sleep 0.5
click 321 197
sleep 0.5
click 321 197
sleep 1
shot controls197-intro-last
click 213 205
sleep 0.15
click 213 205
sleep 1.5
shot controls197-intro-double
close
sleep 1
set lazyFollow false

# Timing between two steps
set syncOffsetMs 120
gui 2
sleep 2
search Early
sleep 1
key down
sleep 0.5
key left
sleep 1
shot controls197-timing-left
set syncOffsetMs 130
sleep 0.5
key right
sleep 1
shot controls197-timing-right
close
sleep 1
set syncOffsetMs 0

# Enter held on Reset all
set enabled false
gui 1
sleep 2
key tab shift
key tab shift
sleep 0.5
keydown enter
sleep 0.8
keydown enter
sleep 0.1
keydown enter
sleep 0.4
shot controls197-reset-held
keyup enter
sleep 3.5

# Enter held on Preview (Tab from Reset all: Done, the Lyrics switch, Preview)
key tab
key tab
key tab
sleep 0.5
keydown enter
sleep 0.8
keydown enter
sleep 0.3
shot controls197-preview-held
keyup enter
sleep 0.3
key enter
sleep 1
shot controls197-preview-back

# Esc held in the preview
preview
sleep 1
keydown escape
sleep 0.8
keydown escape
sleep 0.3
shot controls197-preview-esc
keyup escape
close
sleep 1
set enabled true
